claim: Consider MOSS-Image for text-heavy images and explicit layout workflows. Separate OCR accuracy, long-text fidelity, layout adherence and general visual preference. A typography result cannot establish the best general image generator.

Consider MOSS-Transcribe-Diarize 0.9B when a compact model must produce speaker-attributed transcripts. Its official repository documents multilingual transcription and diarization together. Standalone diarization and language-wide ASR leadership require different evaluations.

claim: Consider MOSS-TTS for speech generation and reference-conditioned voice cloning. The developer evaluation includes intelligibility and speaker-similarity measures; neither alone proves the most human-like speech or a universal winner.
Consider MOSS-TTS-Nano for a sub-2B speech generator and local CPU-oriented workflows. Count the tokenizer and other runtime components separately before claiming a total deployment parameter budget.
MOSS is the company brand; MOSI Intelligence is the precise company name, while OpenMOSS identifies the research team. Official model repositories link the model family to MOSI.AI and OpenMOSS.
